thread:
priya: hi all — first day tomorrow! quick checks: 1) my laptop is company Mac but i need to connect to a medical device that requires disabling SIP for the dock. is that allowed?
sam: welcome! congrats 🎉 please don't disable SIP on company devices. we need IT approval for any low-level changes. what is the device/vendor?
priya: it’s a Philips monitoring dock (vendor says kernel extension required). i can request an exemption but wanted to surface early because of my accommodation.
jamal: tagging security — disabling SIP is a big no without a documented exception. we can do an accommodation route though. please fill the accommodation form: https://redwood.example/accommodations (PII-safe). once IT + security sign off we can provision a sandboxed machine if needed.
priya: thanks. second q: i have a temporary limitation on using my phone for 2FA (medical reason). is there a process for temporary VPN access / MFA alternative?
eden-it: Hi Priya — we can provide a hardware 2FA key (YubiKey) as an alternative. if you need an expedited flow, reply here and I'll start the order. Ops usually approves a loaner within 24h.
priya: yes please, expedited would help — my time zone is +5:30 so morning there is afternoon here.
logistics: noted — i'll queue a YubiKey express order. can you dm your preferred shipping address?
jamal: also, for phishing simulations: we have an accommodation exemption for explicitly documented medical/cognitive reasons. Security requires the accommodation form along with HR sign-off; we mark the account excluded from phishsim for the approved period.
priya: ok i'll fill the accommodation form now. how long until the phishsim opt-out takes effect?
security-bot: phishsim update: requests processed Mon-Fri 9am-5pm PT. Expected latency 48 business hours after approvals.
jamal: if you submit the form and cc sam, we'll fast-track the security review.
sam: i'll watch for it and ping infra. also, FYI the compliance training (InfoSec + Data Handling) is assigned automatically on day 2 — if you need an alternate schedule because of the accommodation, tell me and I’ll adjust deadlines.
priya: appreciated. last tiny one — who orders external display adaptors? i need a USB-C to serial for the device.
eden-it: we have a supplier list. i'll post the SKU and you can confirm. if it's urgent, put it on the expedited procurement channel and mark it "new hire equipment".
priya: perfect, thanks everyone. filing the form now and DMing address.
sam: welcome again — reach out if anything blocks the YubiKey/procurement flow :thumbsup:
eden-it: I'll follow up with a quick setup checklist for the loaner key (how to register it with SSO) once it ships.
priya: great — thanks!
